message:
Four rigid wheels with grousers, meaning traction bars, carry the device over Black Point 1 (BP-1) simulant. E1 (hou.usra.edu — 5068.PDF — 2019) gives peak friction 39 to 51 degrees with negligible cohesion and E2 (impact.colorado.edu — Sanchez, David Poster 2024 (12JUL24) — 2024) gives bulk density near 1.6 to 1.9 grams per cubic centimetre, so large 300 millimetre diameter wheels at about 9.82 kilopascal ground pressure float with shallow sinkage and grousers bite without the extra mass, power and height of tracks.

A front transverse rotating drum, meaning bucket-wheel cutter, digs with low shock. E4 (sciences.ucf.edu — ConstructionwithRegolith — 2017) and E5 (core.ac.uk — PowerPoint Presentation) report drum torque tests averaging about 39 newton cutting force, and E6 (newatlas.com — NASA working on RASSOR robot space excavator) describes the Regolith Advanced Surface Systems Operations Robot (RASSOR) counter-rotating drums for net-zero force. A single drum leaves about 39 newton reaction versus about 589 newton weight at the 60 kilogram limit, a 0.066 pull ratio, so traction holds if cut stays shallow near 30 millimetre, keeping drive power and chassis mass down and limiting tipping load for dumping.

I withhold ready while mass-energy and dump tip proofs owned by others stay open, and I condition support for integration on their closure.
